title: Random Projections for Spectral Algorithms: Optimal Rates in Sobolev Norms
abstract: arXiv:2610.30948v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Random projections (RP) offer an effective method for reducing computational and storage overhead while preserving the geometric structure of data. However, existing studies have primarily focused on the optimal generalization performance of specific kernel-regularized algorithms with RP in the well-specified setting and under restrictive conditions. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive and improved analysis of the generalization performance of RP-based spectral algorithms under general conditions \change{without sacrificing statistical efficiency}. By leveraging the embedding property of the reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) and a refined analysis of the operator similarity, we establish optimal learning rates in Sobolev norms that match the minimax lower bounds up to logarithmic factors. translated_title: 谱算法的随机投影：Sobolev范数下的最优速率
translated_abstract: 随机投影（RP）提供了一种在保持数据几何结构的同时降低计算与存储开销的有效方法。然而，现有研究主要集中于在设定良好且条件受限的情况下，针对采用随机投影的特定核正则化算法的最优泛化性能。在本文中，我们在不牺牲统计效率的前提下，对基于随机投影的谱算法在一般条件下的泛化性能进行了全面且改进的分析。通过利用再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）的嵌入性质以及对算子相似性的精细化分析，我们建立了Sobolev范数下的最优学习速率，其在对数因子范围内与极小极大下界相匹配。对于随机投影的两种常见实现方式——随机化草图和Nyström子采样（均匀采样或基于杠杆得分的采样），我们表明（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文利用RKHS嵌入性质与算子相似性的精细分析，证明了基于随机投影（随机化草图与Nyström子采样）的谱算法在一般条件下于Sobolev范数中达到匹配极小极大下界的最优学习速率，且不牺牲统计效率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes optimal learning rates in Sobolev norms, matching minimax lower bounds up to logarithmic factors, for spectral algorithms based on random projections (randomized sketches and Nyström sub-sampling) under general conditions without sacrificing statistical efficiency.
